title: Lab-03 candidate: cumulative evidence and models

questions.prompt: Virtual lab 3: original bounded data evidence. Authored form A. Four independently prepared cultures have [1000, 2000, 3000, 4000] viable cells and [500, 1200, 2100, 3200] lineage-marker-positive viable cells, paired by culture order. A lineage-restricted clone maintains its phenotype across passages; no broad potency assay is supplied. A defined mature-function assay is below its positive control; matrix ligand accessibility and exposure duration differ between conditions. Marker counts are marginal, not joint states. Use equal-culture summaries.

options: Serial maintenance supports self-renewal in the tested context; restricted lineage production does not establish totipotency.
Self-renewal and differentiation are the same assay.

response_fields.prompt: Calculate equal-culture mean marker-positive percent. Report exactly 3 significant figures.

options: Use the marker as proof of mature function.
Match signals, neighbors, accessible matrix ligand and duration; assay marker and defined function separately with controls.
Ignore timing and ligand presentation because the lineage name is fixed.
